testingFrequency: Installation testing; annual testing for high-hazard water connections
dueBasis: Buda says BPAT testing and maintenance reports must be submitted online through a Vepo-hosted site, new construction devices must be installed and tested, and high-hazard water connections are subject to annual testing.

submissionMethods.label: Vepo BPAT testing and maintenance reports

penalties: Buda's public workflow requires online BPAT report submission through Vepo and City registration for BPATs wishing to perform testing.
sourceExcerpt: Buda requires Vepo-hosted online BPAT report submission, City registration for BPATs, new-construction device testing, and annual testing for high-hazard connections.
verdictSummary: Buda is a strong Central Texas portal page because it combines Vepo-hosted online report submission, registered BPAT handling, new-construction testing, and high-hazard annual testing.
whoIsAffected: Buda new construction, high-hazard commercial, industrial, and residential water connections, and BPATs submitting test and maintenance reports.
residentialNotes: Residential users matter when a high-hazard water connection or sprinkler-related backflow device is present.
Buda recommends annual checks and requires annual testing for high-hazard water connections.
commercialNotes: Commercial and industrial high-hazard connections are explicitly listed in Buda's annual testing enforcement group.
BPAT report submission is not just a paper form; it runs through the Vepo-hosted route.

annualTesting.summary: Buda enforces annual testing on high-hazard water connections and requires online report submission through Vepo.
highlights: High-hazard commercial, industrial, and residential connections are annual.
New construction backflow devices must be installed and tested.
BPAT reports must be submitted through the Vepo-hosted site.
workflowSteps: Confirm whether the connection is high hazard or tied to new construction.
Use a BPAT registered with the City of Buda.
Submit the BPAT testing and maintenance report through Vepo.

irrigation.summary: Buda specifically recommends backflow protection on sprinkler systems and requires installation and testing for covered assemblies.
highlights: Sprinkler systems are called out in Buda's backflow prevention guidance.
New construction devices must be tested.
workflowSteps: Confirm whether the sprinkler or irrigation assembly is covered by Buda's high-hazard or new-construction rule.
Submit through the Vepo-hosted report path.

fireLine.summary: Buda's page does not publish a separate fire-line section, so fire-related assemblies should be checked through the City and handled by an appropriately qualified BPAT.
highlights: The public page centers on high-hazard and registered BPAT rules.
Fire-related devices should be verified with the City before scheduling.
Vepo submission remains the report route when a test is required.
workflowSteps: Ask Buda whether the fire-related assembly is handled under the high-hazard testing rule.
Use an appropriately licensed and City-registered BPAT.
Submit the result through the Vepo-hosted workflow.
Use Buda's cross-connection page to classify high-hazard, new construction, or sprinkler context.
Use a BPAT registered with the City of Buda.
Submit test and maintenance reports through the Vepo-hosted workflow.
Keep annual high-hazard and new-construction testing rules separate.
failureHighlights: BPATs must be registered with the City of Buda to perform testing.

costBand.testingRange: Private Buda pricing varies by device type and whether the connection is high hazard.
costBand.repairRetestRange: Repair and retest costs depend on assembly condition and access.
costBand.pricingNotes: The public page is stronger on submission and registration workflow than on retail quote ranges.
